import TransposeFollowup.SignedOverlapData
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]

def componentChecks : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut rows := 0
  let mut cells := 0
  let mut fits := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for F in cases do
    for n in List.range 25 do
      for i in List.finRange n do
        rows := rows + 1
        let row := F.componentRow i
        let massBound := F.integerOperandConstant^2*(n+1)^2
        let wordBound := 2^(F.componentWidth n)
        for j in List.range (n+1) do
          let v := SignedComponents.scan row.deltaLeft row.deltaRight j
          let operands := [row.sourceLeft,row.sourceRight,row.lower,row.upper,v.1,v.2]
          if !(operands.all (fun p => p.mass ≤ massBound)) then failures := failures+1
          for p in operands do
            for q in operands do
              fits := fits+1
              if !(p.positive+q.negative < wordBound) then failures := failures+1
        for j in List.finRange n do
          cells := cells+1
          if row.hit j.val != F.overlapTest i j then failures := failures+1
  return (rows,cells,fits,failures)
#eval componentChecks
